title: Composition of unbounded right derived functors preserving K-injectives
statement: Let C,D,E be abelian categories with chosen derived categories, and assume C,D admit K-injective resolutions [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let F:C→D, G:D→E, H:C→E be additive functors. If F carries K-injective complexes to K-injective complexes and e:F⋙G≅H is a natural isomorphism, then the canonical unbounded right derived functors have a natural isomorphism RF⋙RG≅RH.

proof.text: Reuse the existing proved source construction rightDerivedFunctorCompIso'. A K-injective representative I computes RF. As F(I) is K-injective, the composite unit for RF⋙RG is an isomorphism on I. The K-injective derivability structure therefore identifies RF⋙RG as the right derived functor of F⋙G. Uniqueness of right derived functors gives R(F⋙G)≅RF⋙RG; invert this and apply the functorial derived isomorphism of e to obtain RF⋙RG≅RH. In the application F=i_* preserves K-injectives because it is right adjoint to the exact i^*.
